programme.desc: Tracy faces no competition in her high school election, but the civics teacher intervenes by encouraging the varsity football player to run for president, resulting in chaos.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Howard Wakefield, a New York City lawyer, hides out in the attic of his home for weeks. When a former boyfriend re-enters his wife's life, he realizes that he may not be able to return to the life he has abandoned.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: After a spurned classmate curses him, a teen will be forever ugly unless he finds love.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A strange ritual soon unravels into a waking nightmare when a woman receives a mysterious box that comes with instructions to place three things inside: something you need, something you hate, and something you love.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: After years of a zombie plague that ravaged Europe, humanity grapples with how to reintegrate the former zombies into society.

programme.title: Movie
programme.sub-title: House at the End of the Street (2012)
programme.desc: A divorcee (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter (Jennifer Lawrence) learn that they have moved next door to a house in which a girl killed her parents, then disappeared, leaving a brother (Max Thieriot) as the only survivor.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A Memphis law school graduate (Matt Damon) aids a battered wife (Claire Danes) and fights a corporate lawyer (Jon Voight) for insurance benefits for a dying man.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: When his new assignment goes awry, an elite soldier finds himself hunted and on the run, caught in a dangerous conspiracy and fighting to stay alive long enough to get home and uncover the true motives of those who betrayed him.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Smugglers, the police, locals and tourists get drawn into a dangerous web of survival, sacrifice and shifting loyalties as Europe faces a surge in migration.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: When a young boy mails his Christmas wish list to Santa with one crucial spelling error, a devilish Jack Black arrives to wreak havoc on the holidays.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A buoy and a satellite meet online long after humanity's extinction. As they learn what life was like on Earth, they discover themselves and what it means to be alive and in love.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Three strong-willed women (Kristen Stewart, Laura Dern, Michelle Williams) strive to forge their own paths amidst the wide-open plains of the American Northwest.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Coerced into working for a crime boss, a talented getaway driver must face the music when a doomed heist threatens his life, love and freedom.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Hoping to stay in the country, a gay man proposes a green card marriage to a female friend in exchange for paying for her IVF treatment. However, things get complicated when his grandmother surprises them with an extravagant Korean wedding banquet.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Indebted to a big-time drug lord, a pot dealer travels to Mexico with a fake family and a camper to pick up a large shipment and smuggle it into the U.S.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Comic misadventures follow when a rising executive (Paul Rudd) brings a blundering IRS agent (Steve Carell) to a monthly gathering hosted by his boss.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: After his girlfriend dies in an accident, a grieving man joins a sleep trial that allows him to rebuild his life with her through the use of lucid dreams.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Best friends Kate and Meg find themselves competing for the same man while waiting for their plane to take off from St. Louis.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Murders draw a young woman (Neve Campbell), a reporter (Courteney Cox Arquette) and an ex-policeman (David Arquette) to the set of a movie inspired by horrific events that they survived.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: The Ghostface Killer returns with a vengeance when self-help author Sidney Prescott arrives in Woodsboro on the last stop of her book tour.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Hoping to close a sale and save their jobs, two co-workers (Jason Bateman, T.J. Miller) must rally their colleagues to throw an epic Christmas party.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A 12-year-old boy starts to see a shadowy figure in the woods after hearing a spooky story at summer camp.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A former criminal gets blackmailed into one last job to collect a mysterious package. After a deadly double-cross, he soon finds himself wounded and on the run from ruthless assassins who will stop at nothing to get what he has.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: After a young man (Shawn Hatosy) crashes into a police cruiser, his father sends him to boarding school where he struggles to be accepted.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A ne'er-do-well auto-parts heir must stop his father's widow from selling the business.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Given one last shot at glory, a former boxing champion has just six days to make weight for a title fight. His obsession soon leaves him at the mercy of a notorious trainer who takes every last ounce from his mind, body and soul.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: A beautiful Mexican-American singer's (Jennifer Lopez) skyrocketing international career ends abruptly.

programme.title: Movie
programme.desc: Dark secrets intrude on the blossoming romance between a widowed merchant and a new arrival in a small North Carolina town.

programme.title: Hiraasat
programme.desc: ACP Ashok Saxena is an honest middle-class police officer who lives with his wife, Shobha, and college-going brother, Rajesh. However, he is framed in a case of drug-trafficking and gets arrested.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Salta Diya
programme.desc: A rich man's wife and a thief's wife simultaneously give birth to twin sons, from which two of them get exchanged. Years later, an unexpected event leads them to swap places once again.

programme.title: Love Mocktail
programme.desc: After rescuing a woman, Adi reminisces about his love life and tells her about all the heartbreaks he endured in his quest to find his true love.

programme.title: Pyar Ki Kahani
programme.desc: Ram, a peon, forms a close friendship with a man named Ravi and values his opinion. However, he is shocked when Ravi disapproves of his fiancee and gets more upset when he learns the reason why.

programme.title: Pighalta Aasman
programme.desc: Delhi-based businesswoman Arti Singh travels to Kashmir to claim her land from Suraj Arora. Soon after Arti and Suraj fall in love with each other, she learns that her friend Anu too loves him.

programme.title: Main Intequam Loonga
programme.desc: Kumar learns that his father, a national level boxing champion, was killed when he refused to lose a fight. He vows to annihilate his father's killers, unaware that he may face tragic consequences.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Max, who lives with his twin sister Shirley in Goa, is enraged when he finds out that she has fallen in love with Rahul, his bitter rival Prakash's younger brother.

programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Action Time
programme.desc: Vedha and his daughter Kanaka are on a killing spree. They are being chased by a cop Rama, but they always manage to escape in the nick of time. Can Rama stop the killings?

programme.title: Biwi.Com
programme.desc: When a pandit predicts that Kishan will marry thrice in his lifetime, his wife Shilpa forces him into a second marriage. When the wives start fighting, a third woman arrives from London for Kishan.

programme.title: Love Mocktail 2
programme.desc: With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is madly in love with Malika, an actress, and travels to her house in Mumbai from Pune after his father scolds him for his decreasing exam scores.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Nazar Ke Samne
programme.desc: Jai, an unemployed drunk, gives false testimony that puts an innocent man in jail for murder. However, he later relents and tries to exonerate him by searching for the real killer.

programme.title: Shehzaade
programme.desc: Suraj, a justice-loving man, must face a series of obstacles when he discovers his widowed mother's affair with a former prisoner.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: In an attempt to fulfill their dreams, three friends get entangled in trouble related to a director's death. Meanwhile, they confront an inspector while trying to save themselves.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.desc: S1 E1Josie Gibson presents as families have a loved one's clutter cleared and valued in secret by antiques expert Dan Hatfield and declutterer Jacqueline McLeod. The first mission is in Somerset, where they help Mel, who is desperate for her husband of three years Paul to rent out his house and move in with her so his clutter has to go. However, this is no easy task as Paul is a private investigator.

programme.title: How to Clean Up for Cash
programme.desc: S1 E2Josie Gibson and the team head to north-east England to help Ashley clear out and value the clutter of her mum Mandy, who has been lured out of the house and is unaware of what is happening. From a Victorian commode to a bust of Elvis, Josie falls in love with Mandy's eclectic taste, but Ashley is determined to see it gone for good.

With analysis from Bryan Habana and David Flatman, pitchside inserts by Claire Thomas and Brian O'Driscoll, and commentary from Miles Harrison and Gordon D'Arcy.

programme.title: EFL Live
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Burnley v Blackburn RoversBurnley v Blackburn Rovers (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents coverage of the Championship match from Turf Moor, as the rivals face each other in the East Lancashire derby. There have been 170 previous meetings between these teams in all competitions, dating back to the 1888/89 season, and it is the Clarets who narrowly hold the better record with 71 wins to Rovers 65, with the other 34 games ending in draws. The most recent meeting was in the 2024/25 campaign and saw Burnley triumph 1-0 at Ewood Park, with the corresponding clash here ending in a 1-1 stalemate. With analysis from Ben Mee and Brad Friedel, commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Lucy Ward, and reports from Katie Shanahan.

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Halle Berry and Toby Stephens. After being betrayed during an operation in North Korea, agent James Bond is held prisoner by a ruthless military leader. A trade-off secures Bond's freedom, but his "00" agent status is withdrawn when he is suspected of leaking secret information. Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

programme.title: Tipping Point: Lucky Stars
programme.desc: S10 E5Ben Shephard asks the questions as Mark Benton, Alex Jones and Shivi Ramoutar answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the better their chances of collecting the £20,000 prize for their selected charity.

The most recent meeting was in the 2024/25 campaign and saw Burnley triumph 1-0 at Ewood Park, with the corresponding clash here ending in a 1-1 stalemate. With analysis from Ben Mee and Brad Friedel, commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Lucy Ward, and reports from Katie Shanahan.

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Halle Berry and Toby Stephens. A trade-off secures Bond's freedom, but his "00" agent status is withdrawn when he is suspected of leaking secret information. Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

programme.title: EFL Live
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Burnley v Blackburn RoversBurnley v Blackburn Rovers (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents coverage of the Championship match from Turf Moor, as the rivals face each other in the East Lancashire derby. There have been 170 previous meetings between these teams in all competitions, dating back to the 1888/89 season, and it is the Clarets who narrowly hold the better record with 71 wins to Rovers 65, with the other 34 games ending in draws. The most recent meeting was in the 2024/25 campaign and saw Burnley triumph 1-0 at Ewood Park, with the corresponding clash here ending in a 1-1 stalemate. With analysis from Ben Mee and Brad Friedel, commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Lucy Ward, and reports from Katie Shanahan.

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Halle Berry and Toby Stephens. After being betrayed during an operation in North Korea, agent James Bond is held prisoner by a ruthless military leader. A trade-off secures Bond's freedom, but his "00" agent status is withdrawn when he is suspected of leaking secret information. Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

programme.title: EFL Live
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Burnley v Blackburn RoversBurnley v Blackburn Rovers (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents coverage of the Championship match from Turf Moor, as the rivals face each other in the East Lancashire derby. There have been 170 previous meetings between these teams in all competitions, dating back to the 1888/89 season, and it is the Clarets who narrowly hold the better record with 71 wins to Rovers 65, with the other 34 games ending in draws. The most recent meeting was in the 2024/25 campaign and saw Burnley triumph 1-0 at Ewood Park, with the corresponding clash here ending in a 1-1 stalemate. With analysis from Ben Mee and Brad Friedel, commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Lucy Ward, and reports from Katie Shanahan.

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Halle Berry and Toby Stephens. After being betrayed during an operation in North Korea, agent James Bond is held prisoner by a ruthless military leader. A trade-off secures Bond's freedom, but his "00" agent status is withdrawn when he is suspected of leaking secret information. Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

programme.desc: S5 E19 — 21/11/2026Action from the latest matches, including Middlesbrough v Bristol City at Riverside Stadium, Swansea City v West Bromwich Albion at Swansea.com Stadium and West Ham United v Preston North End at London Stadium.

programme.title: Grantchester
programme.desc: S9 E3Following the departure of Will Davenport, Grantchester has a new vicar in the form of Alphy Kottaram but Geordie manages to get off on the wrong foot with him. The pair soon find themselves teaming up to investigate the murder of a local landowner.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: S5 E7The Fletchers are back at the Royal Cheshire Show, but this year they're swapping the show ring for trading. For Marnie and her lamb, Hope, it's an emotional journey towards their debut in the Young Handlers class. First-time nerves are running high, but preparations take a worrying turn when Kelvin spots maggots in Hope's fleece.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Blair CastleThe chef's culinary tour of Britain continues in Scotland with a trip to Blair Castle in the Highlands, where he takes a tour of the grounds and cooks venison with beetroot and blackberries in the castle's walled garden. Later, James gets a masterclass in Highland gaming as two young brothers David and Harry share the secrets to the famous caber toss.

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: S9 E36In a rugby-themed show, James cooks for former England player Maggie Alphonsi and ITV Sport's chief presenter Mark Pougatch. Chef Doug Crampton and baker Richard Bertinet are also in the kitchen and gardening expert David Domeney talks growing and nurturing apples.

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: E90 — 22/11/2026A round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: S8 E31Joining Alan at Manor Farm this time are Chelsea Detective stars Adrian Scarborough and Vanessa Emme, and farmers Kelvin and Liz Fletcher. The pygmy goats make a return to the farm, and vintage racing cars take centre stage on our driveway. Plus, Tom Surgery has pudding-inspired cocktails.

programme.title: EFL Live
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Burnley v Blackburn RoversBurnley v Blackburn Rovers (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents coverage of the Championship match from Turf Moor, as the rivals face each other in the East Lancashire derby. There have been 170 previous meetings between these teams in all competitions, dating back to the 1888/89 season, and it is the Clarets who narrowly hold the better record with 71 wins to Rovers 65, with the other 34 games ending in draws. The most recent meeting was in the 2024/25 campaign and saw Burnley triumph 1-0 at Ewood Park, with the corresponding clash here ending in a 1-1 stalemate. With analysis from Ben Mee and Brad Friedel, commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Lucy Ward, and reports from Katie Shanahan.

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: Spy adventure starring Pierce Brosnan, Halle Berry and Toby Stephens. After being betrayed during an operation in North Korea, agent James Bond is held prisoner by a ruthless military leader. A trade-off secures Bond's freedom, but his "00" agent status is withdrawn when he is suspected of leaking secret information. Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

programme.title: Tipping Point: Lucky Stars
programme.desc: S10 E5Ben Shephard asks the questions as Mark Benton, Alex Jones and Shivi Ramoutar answer questions to win turns on an arcade-style machine. Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the better their chances of collecting the £20,000 prize for their selected charity.

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: S11 E93 — 22/11/2026 - 1Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: Wicked
programme.desc: Fantasy musical starring Cynthia Erivo and Ariana Grande-Butera. Elphaba Thropp is an outcast among the citizens of Oz due to her green skin and magical powers. When she arrives at the prestigious Shiz University, she is given a chance to develop her abilities and finds an unlikely friend in the popular Galinda. But something's rotten in the state of Oz, and the two young women arrive at a crossroads from which there'll be no turning back.

programme.title: Sorry, I Didn't Know

programme.title: Per och Marie - historien om Roxette
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Avsnitt 1Marie Fredriksson från Östra Ljungby och Per Gessle från Halmstad träffas i musikkretsar under tidigt 80-tal. När Pers karriär efter Gyllene Tider börjar dala börjar Maries solostjärna stiga - och mot alla odds gör de en låt tillsammans som faktiskt blir en hit: Neverending Love 1986. Genom deras egna filmer får vi följa med från första singeln fram till att deras stora genombrott med The Look står för dörren.

programme.title: Queen of the castle
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Rosé RodeoNär byggprojektet på slottet försenas av tillståndsfrågor lägger Ann all energi på ny, kunglig inredning - och en extravagant rosé-rodeo för en nybliven singel. programme.desc: S23 E9 — Avsnitt 9Korta inslag samlar aktuell samhällsinformation i koncentrerat format.

programme.title: Gift vid första ögonkastet XL
programme.desc: S15 E12 — "Nån ljuger!"Stämningen är allt annat än på topp efter en skakig parmiddag. Sofia har funderingar kring relationen med Rasmus och vänder sig till Olivia för råd. Under en dramatisk löftesceremoni kommer saker upp till ytan - och kvällen tar en oväntad vändning för två av paren.

programme.title: Hem till bondgården
programme.desc: S2 E5 — Fårklippning på egen handSommaren är här och det är dags att klippa fåren. Kelvin provar att använda en elektrisk klippmaskin, men när batteriet tar slut är bara halva jobbet gjort. Milo hjälper till att reparera en gammal stenmur och Kelvin deltar i ett välgörenhetslopp på cykel för att uppmärksamma bönder som har det svårt. Samtidigt pågår de sista förberedelserna inför Royal Cheshire Show.

programme.title: Skärgårdsdoktorn
programme.desc: S3 E3 — Gubbar och sjöjungfrurJohan Steen får en kvartstjänst på servicehuset Lärkan och blir varse den brist på tid och känslomässigt engagemang som råder i omvårdnaden av de gamla. Wilma ger sig olovandes ut på båtfärd med Maddo, Linus och Henrik, men det blir inte riktigt som de tänkt sig. I rollerna: Samuel Fröler, Ebba Hultkvist, Marie Richardson, Sten Ljunggren, Helena Brodin, Göran Engman, Gunilla Röör, Tord Peterson, Bengt Järnblad, Stina Ekblad och Eva Stellby.

programme.title: Det sitter i väggarna
programme.desc: S10 E3 — Trumpetarbostället – Brunnsta (Uppland)I den uppländska byn Brunnsta bor Thomas och Katarina på en gård med ett förflutet som bostad för arméns trumpetare. Vad det egentligen innebär och vad som hänt på gården försöker antikexperten Rickard Thunér ta reda på. I sitt sökande finner han en över 200 år gammal ögonvittnesskildring av slagfältets fasor med isande kyla, hunger och död. Byggnadsantikvarien Erika Åberg river en modern walk-in closet och plockar fram originalmurstocken som varit gömd bakom gipsskivor.

programme.title: Supervulkanen Toba och hotet mot mänskligheten
programme.desc: Var det nära att människans historia tog slut för 74 000 år sedan? Då exploderade supervulkanen Toba i dagens Indonesien och spred aska i atmosfären. Nu söker forskare på tre kontinenter efter spåren av katastrofen. Vad hände med klimatet - och hur överlevde våra förfäder? Vulkanaska, genetiska ledtrådar och dramatiska rekonstruktioner tar oss närmare svaret på hur ett enda vulkanutbrott kan ha förändrat vår historia.

I författarpanelen är det dags för bekännelser från läsfronten när Agnes Lidbeck, Christoffer Carlsson och Ulf Karl Olov Nilsson bokbiktar sig - vilka är klassikerna de inte kommer läsa om, dikterna de fulgråter till, böckerna de ljuger om att de läst och böckerna de själva är avundsjuka på att inte ha skrivit?

programme.title: Studie i mänskligt beteende
programme.desc: Lena Anderssons Augustprisnominerade berättelse bjuder på både humor och skärpa. Här som pjäs på Kulturhuset Stockholms Stadsteater. Vi träffar besserwissern, paragrafryttaren, neurotikern, ensamvargen och flera i välbekanta och prekära situationer. Och det gäller att lyssna noga och försöka förstå också det som inte sägs. Att hitta sin egen väg bland alla oskrivna regler och sociala koder kan vara svårt. Regi: Sissela Kyle. I rollerna: Astrid Drettner, Annika Hallin, Isabelle Kyed, Siham Shurafa, Pablo Leiva Wenger, Emil Hedayat och Sofia Papadimitriou Ledarp.

programme.title: The Piano
programme.desc: S1 E6 — KonsertenHela den avslutande konserten från Royal Festival Hall, där vinnaren i jakten på Storbritanniens bästa amatörpianist avgörs. Konserten innehåller även musikaliska framträdanden av domarna, världspianisten Lang Lang och popstjärnan Mika. Programledare: Claudia Winkleman.

programme.title: Mördarens son
programme.desc: När Tabaré var tre år dömdes hans föräldrar för ett dubbelmord i Malmö och han placerades i familjehem. Efter att själv suttit i fängelse söker han, känd idag som boxaren och artisten Rankz, sanningen om sin fosterhemsplacering och hur det påverkat hans liv som präglats av droger och brott. Kan han bryta ett arv av kriminalitet och trauman samtidigt som hans frigivna pappa återvänder och en nära vän mördas? Svensk dokumentär från 2026 av Sebastian Peña Rojas och Jesper Klemedsson Sotomayor.

programme.title: Bardot
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Avsnitt 1Brigitte Bardot (1934-2025) var en av 1900-talets mest berömda filmstjärnor. Men bakom glamouren och berömmelsen fanns ett liv präglat av stormiga kärleksaffärer, filmskapare som exploaterade hennes privatliv samt en skoningslös press. 1973 lämnade hon plötsligt strålkastarljuset för att i stället ägna sitt liv åt kampen för djurens rättigheter och miljön. På senare år blev hon omstridd efter upprepade rasistiska uttalanden. I sitt sista framträdande framför kameran delar hon med sig av sin personliga berättelse om livet och drivkrafterna bakom sina livsval. Med personliga intervjuer, unikt arkivmaterial och exklusiva bilder från hennes privata egendom La Madrague tecknas ett nära porträtt av kvinnan bakom den mytomspunna stjärnan.

programme.title: Hundra procent bonde

Ett nässelutdrag blir en illaluktande blandning - men det fungerar. En koreansk lerugn ska byggas, lökskörden beundras och franska skruvar monteras i kvarnstocken.

programme.title: Drömlandet
programme.desc: S2 E3 — Avsnitt 3Carina Bergfeldt och Farah Abadis resa genom Australien går vidare. På väg till Brisbane råkar de ut för problem men en räddare i nöden dyker upp. Väl framme i Brisbane träffar Farah människor som flyttat till landet i jakt på ett bättre liv, men såren från hemlandet visar sig vara svåra att läka. Carina och Farah åker vidare mot den mytomspunna outbacken som täcker större delen av landets yta. Där träffar de äventyraren Charlie och hans fru Deborah och tillsammans övernattar de ute i den röda öknen under bar himmel.

programme.title: Jakttid
programme.desc: S9 E10 — RevanschandaMilla och Samuli hoppas på bättre jaktlycka under en ny dag i vildmarken. Aki får sällskap av dottern Adela på en fisketur, Manu satsar på ett nytt projekt och Mehtämikko återvänder till norra Sverige för att lyckas med det som gick fel förra året.

programme.title: Världens natur: Kingdom
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Krokodilens listDen skadade vildhunden Flint är helt beroende av sin flock, men visar sig också vara ovärderlig för Storms största valpkull hittills. Samtidigt hårdnar kampen mellan leoparderna: Olimba kämpar för att behålla sitt revir medan dottern Mutima letar efter ett eget hem. Hyenorna återförenas och lejonflocken växer sig starkare, tills naturens krafter, inte rivalerna, plötsligt hotar att rubba hela maktordningen.

programme.title: Hem till bondgården
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Restaurering och reflektionFrån skådespelare och storstadsliv till småbarnsfamiljeliv på en stor bondgård. Kelvin och Liz byter röda mattan mot röd traktor när de satsar allt på en för dem mer meningsfull tillvaro i sin version av det enkla livet på landet. Det är inte så lätt alla gånger med fyra barn att ta hand om jämte djuren och den enorma gården. Men det är deras dröm och den är sann. Här får vi se glimtar av deras vedermödor på gården.

programme.title: Babel
programme.desc: S44 E9 — Isabella Nilsson och författarpanelen får ett uppdragFörfattaren och översättaren Isabella Nilsson debuterade med ungdomsromanen Verklighetsprojektet, och slog igenom med essäromanen Nonsensprinsessans dagbok. En sjukskrivning, som nominerades till Nordiska rådets litteraturpris. Nu kommer hennes nionde bok "Om varmhållning av levande döda" - elva texter med teman som ensamhet och skrivande. Författarpanelen med Jonathan Brott, Aris Fioretos och Maria Maunsbach får i uppgift att rekommendera böcker åt varandra och i förlängningen också åt tittarna. Programledare: Jessika Gedin.

programme.title: Cyklopernas land
programme.desc: S11 E12Ett smart, dumt och roligt program om veckans kultursnackisar. Programledare Christopher Garplind bjuder in några av landets smartaste kulturhjärnor som tar sig an stora och små frågor från veckan som passerat. Det blir kul snack, vassa meningsutbyten, intellektuella djupdyk och riktigt mycket helt vanligt trams.

Katniss och en grupp rebeller från Distrikt 13 förbereder sig nu för den episka slutstriden som kommer att avgöra Panems framtid.

I en kamp för att rädda sin syster pressas Ida till det ytterstaoch när allt tycks förlorat är det mer som står på spel än bara överlevnad.

programme.title: Blacklight

När Block upptäcker att FBI-chefen har en hemlig agenda, ”Operation Unity”, som drabbar vanliga medborgare så måste Block välja sida. Genom att gå emot Robinson och samtidigt försöka avslöja ”Operation Unity” så riskerar Block både sitt och sin familjs liv.

Högt uppe i en strömförande ledning i Trollhättan tvingas Christoffer och Markus kämpa mot regnet från en svajig helikopterlina. Längre norrut slår blixthalkan till i Vassijaure, där Elin och Louise råkar illa ut i iskylan under ett stationsbyte. Ovan jord väntar ett jobbigt uppdrag för elektrikern Erik men arbetet får ett efterlängtat avbrott när han träffar sin sambo Bella. programme.title: Maybe I Do
programme.desc: Michelle och Allen har nått den punkt i sitt förhållande när de överväger nästa steg, att gifta sig. De bestämmer sig för att bjuda in sina föräldrar så de äntligen får träffas. Det visar sig dock att föräldrarna redan känner varandra väl, alltför väl, vilket leder till en tumult kväll där många hemligheter avslöjas och det egentliga värdet av ett äktenskap ifrågasätts.

programme.title: Dagboken
programme.desc: I Seabrook, North Carolina på 1940-talet tillbringar överklassflickan Allie Hamilton (Rachel McAdams) och den lokala pojken Noah Calhoun (Ryan Gosling) en passionerad och sorglös sommar tillsammans djupt förälskade i varandra. Men när sommaren når sitt slut separerar krig och plikt det unga paret. I nutid besöker en äldre herre (James Garner) ett sjukhem för att läsa ur sin dagbok för en kvinna (Gena Rowlands) vars minnen tynar bort. När han berättar om två unga älskare med livet framför sig återupplever hans älskade Allie en passion som aldrig dog; ett band mellan två ordinära personer som tack vare kärlekens styrka, makt och skönhet blir extraordinärt.

programme.title: Efterlyst
programme.desc: S68 E13Pedofiler finns överallt i samhället. Att som barn våga berätta kan vara enormt svårt och blir barnen lyssnade på? På nätet eskalerar spridningen av barnpornografi och globala nätverk samarbetar och delar material. Det finns metoder och läkemedel för att minska en persons sexualdrift, men kan man bota en pedofil? Vad behöver samhället göra för att skydda barnen? I det här programmet träffar vi offer som blivit drabbade men även en dömd pedofil vars nyfikenhet drog honom till Darknet.

programme.desc: Die heute ist eine Nachrichtensendung des ZDF mit aktuellen Meldungen des Tages aus den Bereichen Politik, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft, Kultur, Gesellschaft, Sport und Wetter. Die Sendung informiert kompakt und verständlich über die wichtigsten Ereignisse im In- und Ausland und ordnet diese journalistisch ein. programme.title: Tagesschau

In bis zu 20 am Tag produzierten Sendungen wird die Komplexität des Weltgeschehens verständlich erklärt und in komprimierter Form über aktuelle politische, wirtschaftliche, soziale, kulturelle, sportliche und sonstige Ereignisse berichtet.

programme.title: Eine Nacht in Bangkok
programme.desc: Zehn Jahre nach ihrer Trennung treffen Katharina und Hektor im Untersuchungsgefängnis wieder aufeinander: Ihre Tochter Lilith sitzt wegen des Verdachts auf mehrere Einbrüche in Haft. Während Hektor zunächst auf die befreundete Anwältin Lydia setzt, beginnen die Eltern doch selbst zu ermitteln. Dabei stoßen sie auf unerwartete Geheimnisse in Liliths Leben und erkennen, wie wenig sie ihre Tochter tatsächlich kennen. Die Suche nach der Wahrheit führt sie nicht nur zu den Hintergründen des Falls, sondern auch zu ihrer gemeinsamen Vergangenheit und der Frage, was Familie wirklich bedeutet.

programme.title: Nürnberg 45 – Im Angesicht des Bösen
programme.desc: Der Nürnberger Prozess gegen die Hauptkriegsverbrecher begann am 20.11.1945. Als Ernst Michel zum ersten Mal die Pressetribüne im Saal 600 betritt, hält er die Nähe zu den Angeklagten kaum aus. Keine zehn Meter sitzt er, der Auschwitz-Überlebende, von Göring und den anderen entfernt. Der Film erzählt einen der wichtigsten Prozesse des Jahrhunderts aus der Perspektive von zwei jungen Menschen, die noch ein halbes Jahr zuvor der Todesmaschinerie der Nazis im KZ Auschwitz ausgeliefert waren.

programme.title: Offenes Geheimnis
programme.desc: Lauras 16 jährige Tochter wird entführt. Doch weder sie noch ihr Mann können das Lösegeld aufbringen. Ein Einsatz der Polizei kommt nicht in Frage. Einzig Lauras Jugendliebe Paco könnte helfen. Doch hinter alledem verbirgt sich etwas, das die Familie und ihr Leben für immer verändern wird.

programme.desc: Hokkaidō ist Japans nördlichste Hauptinsel und ein Paradies für Naturfreunde. Dichter Schnee und eine von Treibeis bedeckte Küste verwandeln sie in ein Winterwunderland.

programme.title: Die Kapverden - Unbekannte Inselwelt
programme.desc: Im Atlantik, etwa 600 Kilometer von der Küste Nordwestafrikas entfernt, liegen die Kapverden. Sie beeindrucken mit vulkanischen Landschaften, grünen Oasen und einer reichen Kultur.

Die Sendung vermittelt aktuelle Eindrücke direkt aus den Regionen und lädt zum Mitreisen ein. Gleichzeitig informiert sie über Temperatur- und Wetterbedingungen vor Ort.

programme.title: ZIB
programme.desc: Die Kurzausgaben der österreichischen Nachrichtensendung Zeit im Bild (ZIB) liefern neben klassischen Nachrichten Informationen über Entwicklungen auf den Finanzmärkten und Expertenanalysen.

programme.title: Sternstunde Philosophie
programme.desc: Sternstunde Philosophie bietet vertiefende Gespräche mit herausragenden Persönlichkeiten aus Kultur, Wissenschaft und Politik. Die Sendung vermittelt lebensnahe Denkanstöße, reflektiert zentrale Fragen unserer Zeit und regt die Zuschauer dazu an, über Gesellschaft, Werte und das menschliche Zusammenleben nachzudenken.

programme.title: erLesen
programme.desc: Das Büchermagazin bespricht Neuerscheinungen und beschäftigt sich mit Kunst- und Kulturthemen. Es treffen einander Prominente, Star- und Nachwuchsautoren, die über Lieblingsbücher, aktuelles Tagesgeschehen, Historisches und Persönliches sprechen.

programme.title: Literaturclub
programme.desc: In der Diskussionssendung werden jeweils vier bis fünf Bücher besprochen: Literaturkritikerinnen und -kritiker debattieren mit prominenten Gästen über Neuerscheinungen, Klassiker und Sachbücher.

programme.title: Sternstunde Kunst
programme.desc: Als Lydia Welti-Escher in Rom ein neues Leben beginnen möchte, ahnt sie nicht, dass ihr einflussreiches Umfeld alles daransetzen wird, dies zu verhindern.

programme.title: ZIB
programme.desc: Die Kurzausgaben der österreichischen Nachrichtensendung Zeit im Bild (ZIB) liefern neben klassischen Nachrichten Informationen über Entwicklungen auf den Finanzmärkten und Expertenanalysen.

programme.title: Almendro - Baum des Lebens
programme.desc: Costa Rica ist ein Bindeglied zwischen Nord- und Südamerika auf einer schmalen Landzunge, die den Pazifischen Ozean von der Karibischen See trennt.Das Land steht auf der Liste der an Biodiversität reichsten Länder ganz oben. Seine Landschaften sind ein Hort genetischer Vielfalt in der Tier- und Pflanzenwelt. Der sogenannte Almendro-Baum beispielsweise bietet unzähligen Wesen Lebensraum, Schutz und Nahrung.Die Dokumentation macht anhand des Almendro-Baumes das ausgetüftelte Nischenprogramm der Fauna eines Tieflandregenwaldes deutlich.

programme.title: Spektakuläre Bergbahnen der Schweiz II
programme.desc: Mit den Schweizer Bergbahnen durch majestätische Landschaften auf die spektakulärsten Gipfel. Diese Folge führt mit der Zahnradbahn auf den Monte Generoso - ein ganz besonderes Erlebnis.

programme.title: Schweizer Hotelgeschichten
programme.desc: „Bellevue des Alpes“ und „Schatzalp“ sind zwei legendäre Berghotels. Die Dokumentation erzählt von ihren Besitzern, ihren Gästen und der magischen Anziehungskraft der Alpen.

programme.title: Schweizer Hotelgeschichten
programme.desc: In der letzten Folge der Reihe «Schweizer Hotelgeschichten» werden zwei weltberühmte Stadthotels besucht: The Dolder Grand in Zürich und Les Trois Rois in Basel. Treffpunkte der High Society - damals wie heute.

programme.title: Schweizer Hotelgeschichten
programme.desc: Die Reihe stellt Schweizer Grandhotels vor. In Teil eins geht es um das Montreux Palace und das Monte Rosa: zwei Hotels, die von den Anfängen der Schweizer Tourismusgeschichte erzählen.

programme.title: Die Kinder des Monsieur Mathieu
programme.desc: Der arbeitslose Komponist Clément Mathieu erhält 1949 eine Anstellung als Aufseher in einem französischen Internat für schwer erziehbare Jungen. Dessen Direktor traktiert seine Schüler nur mit Prügel und Arrest. Gegen den Widerstand des Direktors gründet Mathieu einen Chor und gewinnt bei den regelmäßigen Proben allmählich das Vertrauen seiner widerspenstigen Schützlinge. Der Lerneifer und die Disziplin der Schüler verbessern sich. Allein der Direktor ist von dieser Entwicklung nicht begeistert.

programme.title: Spurlos - Ein Rothschild-Krimi aus Wien
programme.desc: Zwei Stadtschlösser, berühmte Gärten und prägende Bauwerke: Die Rothschilds formten Wien wie kaum eine andere Familie. Warum sind ihre Spuren heute fast verschwunden?

programme.title: heute
programme.desc: Die heute ist eine Nachrichtensendung des ZDF mit aktuellen Meldungen des Tages aus den Bereichen Politik, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft, Kultur, Gesellschaft, Sport und Wetter. Die Sendung informiert kompakt und verständlich über die wichtigsten Ereignisse im In- und Ausland und ordnet diese journalistisch ein. Ergänzt wird sie durch Hintergrundberichte, Live-Schalten und Korrespondentenbeiträge. Durch ihre klare Struktur und verlässliche Berichterstattung gehört sie zu den festen Informationsformaten im deutschen Fernsehen und bietet täglich einen schnellen Überblick über das aktuelle Geschehen.

programme.title: 3sat-Wetter
programme.desc: Die Sendung 3sat-Wetter zeigt die aktuelle Wetterlage und berichtet außerdem über die Wettervorhersage für die nächsten Tage aus den drei folgenden 3sat-Ländern: Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz.

programme.title: NZZ Format
programme.desc: Fernsehen von Format! NZZ Format ist «Neue Zürcher Zeitung» zum Anschauen: Geballtes Wissen wird zu gebündelter Information, spannend erzählt und visuell ästhetisch umgesetzt. Thematisch am Puls der Zeit, journalistisch relevante Themen vertieft in 30 Minuten. Aus dem internationalen Weltgeschehen, Gesellschaftspolitik und Wissenschaft.

programme.title: Schätze der Welt - Erbe der Menschheit
programme.desc: Im Süden Mexikos errichteten die Maya in ihrer Blütezeit eine bedeutende Stadt, bevor ihre Kultur vor Ankunft der Spanier unterging. Nach der Freilegung aus dem Urwald suchen Archäologen nach Gründen.

programme.title: Tagesschau
programme.desc: Das Flaggschiff unter den deutschen Nachrichtensendungen ist gleichzeitig die dienstälteste noch bestehende Sendung im deutschen Fernsehen. In bis zu 20 am Tag produzierten Sendungen wird die Komplexität des Weltgeschehens verständlich erklärt und in komprimierter Form über aktuelle politische, wirtschaftliche, soziale, kulturelle, sportliche und sonstige Ereignisse berichtet.

programme.title: Tatort
programme.desc: Jahre nach einem verheerenden Hochhausbrand mit 13 Toten trifft Kommissar Hamza Kulina auf einer Mahnwache seine Ex-Freundin wieder. Almila hat ihre Mutter in den Flammen verloren und kämpft seither unermüdlich für Gerechtigkeit.

programme.title: Neues Land
programme.desc: Die Geologin Ina Sedlitz kehrt nach vielen Jahren in ihr Heimatdorf Neukirch zurück – ein Ort, der sich vom ehemaligen Braunkohlerevier in ein beliebtes Tourismusziel verwandelt hat.

programme.title: Shorta - Das Gesetz der Straße
programme.desc: Die Polizei von Kopenhagen sieht sich schweren Rassismus-Vorwürfen ausgesetzt: Nach einem brutalen Einsatz liegt ein 19-jähriger im Koma. Die Polizisten Mike Andersen und Jens Høyer brechen zu einer Streifenfahrt in die Hochhaussiedlung Svalegården auf. Der rassistisch auftretende Andersen gibt den starken Mann. Als der 19-jährige stirbt, wendet sich die Gewalt plötzlich gegen die Gesetzeshüter.

programme.title: SF unterwegs
programme.desc: Dichte Wälder, weite Seenlandschaften und Häuser wie aus dem Märchenbuch: Schweden gehört zu den populärsten europäischen Reisezielen. Die Reise beginnt in Motala am Göta-Kanal.

programme.title: Abenteuer Lappland - Die Husky-Tour des Lebens
programme.desc: Im Dezember 2019, kurz vor Weihnachten, nehmen sich fünf Abenteurer eine fünftägige Auszeit. Bei minus 30 Grad sind sie 200 Kilometer in der Wildnis Lapplands mit Schlittenhunden unterwegs.

programme.desc: Ausbrechen aus dem Alltag. Das tun, wovon man immer geträumt hat. Sechs Schweizerinnen und Schweizer erfüllen sich den Traum, in Tansania den höchsten Berg Afrikas zu besteigen.

programme.title: Abenteuer Kilimandscharo - Auf Expedition in Tansania
programme.desc: Der Kilimandscharo gilt als Traumziel. Der höchste Berg Afrikas ist 5895 Meter hoch und derjenige der Seven Summits, der einfach zu besteigen ist. Darum zieht er viele Touristen an.

programme.title: nano
programme.desc: Wutausbrüche, Ängste, Schlafprobleme - jedes fünfte Kind in Deutschland fühlt sich psychisch überdurchschnittlich belastet. Was ist eine Phase? Wann braucht ein Kind Hilfe? Autorin und Podcasterin Julia Knörnschild geht für ARD Wissen auf eine persönliche Reise: Sie begleitet den vierzehnjährigen Elias in einer Münchner Tagesklinik und trifft Mareike, die über Monate einen Therapieplatz für ihre Tochter sucht. Die emotionale Doku zeigt praktische Wege zur Hilfe, macht Mut und wirbt für mehr Offenheit im Umgang mit einem Thema, das viele Familien betrifft.

programme.title: Matt Rife: Only Fans
programme.desc: Matt Rife's debut stand-up special, a culmination of his first ten years doing comedy starting at age 15. Fan-funded and self-produced, it showcases his sharp crowd work, edgy humor, and personal storytelling.

programme.title: Paul Foot: Dissolve
programme.desc: Paul Foot's most personal show ever. In 2022 something momentous changed for him, and in Dissolve he reveals how he discovered the secret of life — with inevitable detours through King Tutankhamun, Sir Cliff Richard, and officious lollipop ladies.

programme.title: Trae Crowder: Trash Daddy
programme.desc: Rural Tennessee's Trae Crowder brings his erudite-yet-trailer'y perspective to life, fatherhood, and America in the 2020s — from his experience as a displaced hillbilly in Hollywood to rednecks' complicated relationship with aliens.

programme.title: Anjelah Johnson-Reyes: Say I Won't
programme.desc: Filmed at the historic Ryman Auditorium in Nashville, Anjelah Johnson-Reyes delivers her sixth stand-up special, covering big life moves, getting older, and the evolving stages of marriage, family, and friendship.

programme.title: Kelsey Cook: Mark Your Territory
programme.desc: Kelsey Cook recently relocated to Minnesota in the dead of winter to move in with her boyfriend. She covers the perks of dating an older man, the chaos of IUD insertions, navigating a parent with dementia, and much more.

programme.title: Kelsey Cook: Mark Your Territory

programme.title: Matt Rife: Matthew Steven Rife
programme.desc: In his second self-produced hour special, built by friends and fans, Matt pushes comedic boundaries with stories, improv, and positive messages. A charismatic look into his wit, sharp humor, and crowd-driven energy.

programme.desc: Kinane explores tolerance and returning to his roots with self-deprecating humor, mining comedy from his suburban life after years on the road — from vegan quesadillas to the Fast and Furious franchise to life with a wayward cat.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the stinky fish then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of rotten fish is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the stinky fish then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of rotten fish is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: Almost 11000 kilometres lie between the northernmost and southernmost point of the 15th meridian east. Here you will find extreme landscapes such as the shimmering heat of Africa or the eternal cold of northern Scandinavia. Five people from Spitsbergen, Namibia, Slovenia, Germany and Poland dedicate their lives to environmental protection.

programme.title: 15th Meridian East - Similarity in Difference
programme.desc: This episode focuses on people from five countries who share a common passion: The production of their own food and food. What culinary treasures are hidden in the different regions, from Spitsbergen to Sweden, Austria, Poland and Chad?

programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Poppy's Promise - Secret Life in a Cornfield
programme.desc: The cornfield - just an area for producing food… or a land full of secrets? This doc portrays a little recognized habitat right next door. The spectacular visuals filmed with state of the art equipment introduce the surprisingly large diversity of field inhabitants. We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about. In the western industrial nations cornfields and woods take up the greatest proportion of rural land. But how much natural life dwells in a cornfield? Why are some cornfield inhabitants harmful and others useful and what do the colourful flowers at the edge of the field promise us? We follow a hamster family through a season full of adventures and are drawn into an unknown world – a world of which we thought we knew everything about.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Carretera de la muerte - the road to death- is one of the most dangerous roads in the world. Year after year many people die here. We accompany trucker Omar and his co-driver Jaime on their trip across the Andes, encountering cyclists, mountain bikers and coca-farmers on the way.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The Sichuan Tibet Highway is the road of longing for many. It leads through fascinating landscapes and remote areas up to the Himalayan Mountains. We accompany truck driver Ren Taiping on his trip to the Tibetan capital city of Lhasa, encountering pilgrims, mountain bikers and nomads on this dangerous journey.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts And Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts And Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world’s ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn’s house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts And Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver’s personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: Animal Cops Miami
